records.subject: You're in -- let's get Union Systems set up
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks for setting up Union Systems on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 0 ([email:8f196914] welcome), kickoff held [calendar:e731f5a2], but no invite sent and no key milestone by day 6 despite a live call. Solo Starter usage with no tickets and no inbound questions suggests low momentum; 8 days left leaves some chance of self-serve activation.

draft.subject: Following up after our kickoff
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for the kickoff last week — good to talk through what Union Systems wants to get out of Wrenfield.

Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the next step that usually makes things click is getting a teammate in alongside you. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first shared project with you.

Best,
Nadia
